description: The primary is behind us. Now the real fight begins. In 69 days, voters across Florida’s 21st District will decide whether we keep moving forward with clean water, safer communities, stronger support for veterans, lower taxes, and an America First agenda, or hand the keys back to the same Washington crowd that made life more expensive and government less accountable.
